critiques.issue: The largest unexplained effect in recent runs: freezing the 64x-LR whitening bias at 0.2 ep cost -0.44 pp off-seed and -0.5 pp scored. The current freeze sits at ~41% of samples, inside the 24 px phase. If so, freezing before the 28 and 32 px switches also costs accuracy. The later-freeze or never-freeze direction was never tried, even though the dgrad saving is only ~0.7-0.9%.

critiques.target: H10 / H2.11 – untested extension of the only confirmed positive lever
critiques.issue: bs 1024 at 32 px is the one accuracy source that replicated across three distinct runs (E084/E085/E095, +0.12-0.18 pp at +2.5%), and E095 showed it acts through update count. On a 300 W PCIe card, the energy-bound phases get relatively more expensive, so the 32 px and 28 px phases and the per-step cost of bs-1024 steps scale differently from 16 px. structured_output.summary:
The loop's reported best, E090 at ~4.46 s, does not meet the gate on average. Its keep counted a bit-identical rerun as confirmation. The first distinct rerun, E094 at 0.7517, puts both the scored and off-seed means at ~0.7523-0.7524, below 0.753, so about half of reruns fail. The only config that is robustly feasible is the E084/E095 family: 0.7549 pooled over three distinct runs, at ~4.70 s.

E090 also contradicts the hypothesis behind it. The 28 px substitution kept every step and still lost as much accuracy per 1% of time as the plain 32 px trim (~0.05-0.065 pp per 1%). So H10's corollary fails, and so does H2.17's 'cheaper than a trim' claim. The full-resolution late phase binds on its own terms, and no Lvl1 explains that.

The off-seed instrument's sd comes from only two distinct samples, so most recent off-seed verdicts are within ~1.5 SE. Only E093 (-0.44) and E083 (-0.29) are clearly real. The tail's mean gain was never shown with an off-seed A/B.

H2's statement is stale. It names the wrong tip, still treats the tail's presence as unresolved, and ranks the whitening-bias freeze first even though that freeze was already in the code. H6 has run out of candidates.

Untried directions worth running:
- Freezing the whitening bias later, or never, given how sensitive E093 was.
- Pushing the one replicated lever further: bs 768 at 32 px, and H10.1.1.
- Depth cuts instead of width cuts.
- Re-checking the filter Muon lr on the mixed-batch tip.
- Accounting for the 300 W PCIe judge when ranking configs whose times are close.

Before any further time cut, add about +0.15 pp of accuracy and measure on seeds 3-26.
